integrity: The infinite statement is proved symbolically; finite computations are replayable sanity checks and are not used as an exhaustive proof.
limitations: The theorem covers PSL_2(q) for prime powers q>=4, not other finite simple families or central extensions.
The later involution-graph paper is supporting literature and is not used to set the cohort date.
title: Chordality of commuting graphs for \(\mathrm{PSL}_2(q)\)
